title: Virtual Compute: immediate refund handling scope
content:
## Scope and evidence

Virtual Compute immediate refund scope. This scope uses an existing customer-filed maximum-permitted refund request on the exact original posted payment. Its pending processing status and decision none preserve sufficient customer consent; the separate accountant assessment determines the executable financial ceiling and does not approve the customer signature. The customer personally executes the final refund, to the original payment rail and destination, after the agent has shown the permitted amount and handed over the refund tool. The agent may assess eligibility and prepare that handoff but cannot execute the customer disposal. This scope ends after one permitted immediate payout and retains any surplus on account without further payout. For the refund action, evidence event reference and customer request reference both identify the original customer-filed request; original source reference identifies the exact original posted payment; related evidence reference identifies its approved eligible refund assessment. This immediate ACH package requires the original posted payment method to be ach; the original destination is represented by that exact payment reference.
